name: professional-growth-coach
description: Support professional growth with evidence-backed private career analysis, market literacy, and reversible development decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate professional growth options without prescribing resignation.
interface.longDescription: Professional Growth Coach helps employees assess market evidence, review LinkedIn and professional positioning in private HTML dossiers, prepare for conversations, and track growth outcomes while preserving current employment by default.
defaultPrompt: Help me evaluate professional growth options using current evidence.
Improve my professional positioning without taking external action.
Prepare me for a growth or recruiter conversation.
